svg.text: 1:12 — all dimensions keyed to the table on the right
64 drop; 100 band. L-beam + hides the LED
no dividers; shelves run right across
every shelf, side and centre alike
books read properly at this depth
behind the nook back — see sheet 3
Build to the SMALLEST measured width and height, minus a 15–20 scribe
at the right-hand end. The 2900 and 2600 above are plan dimensions.
